jobs.description:
What will you do?
As a Mobile Engineering Manager at Rebtel, you will lead the engineers behind our iOS and Android apps, combining hands-on native mobile development with coaching and team leadership. Your daily work will focus on building high-quality mobile experiences, driving technical excellence, and helping engineers grow in their craft. You will also champion the effective use of AI-assisted development to improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering standards and ownership.
This is not a management-only role. You will write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help solve difficult technical problems while taking responsibility for the team's development and delivery. Your impact will come from both what you build and how you help others grow.
Areas of ownership:

Coach and develop engineers through regular one-to-ones, clear feedback and career development. Help people strengthen their technical judgment, grow their skills and take greater ownership.

Stay hands-on with native development. Write and review production code, pair with engineers, and help investigate challenging bugs and performance issues using native platform tools.

Help the team use AI effectively. Lead by example with AI-assisted development tools, share practical approaches and coach engineers to critically evaluate outputs while maintaining code quality, security and ownership.

Drive native app excellence. Set high standards for performance, stability, accessibility and user experience across iOS and Android. Guide technical decisions, architecture, testing and release practices.

Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Product, Design and Backend Engineering to turn customer needs into clear priorities, deliver valuable features and balance short-term goals with long-term app quality.

Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Hire and develop great engineers, set clear expectations and create an environment where people take initiative, solve problems and take pride in what they deliver.

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. English is our working language, but you'll hear many different languages in our Stockholm office.

A strong track record as a native mobile engineer, with production iOS or Android apps you have personally designed, built and shipped.

Deep hands-on expertise in native iOS development (Swift/Objective-C) or Android development (Kotlin/Java). You understand native architecture, UI, app lifecycle, concurrency, performance and debugging, and are comfortable contributing production code today. You can guide technical decisions across both platforms, although equal expertise in both is not required. Experience limited to React Native or other cross-platform frameworks does not meet this requirement.

Experience leading and developing engineers, including coaching, giving feedback, supporting career growth and managing performance. You know how to stay technically involved without taking over.

Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools. You understand where they add value, where they fall short and how to validate their output.

Strong engineering judgment and the ability to make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing quality, delivery and long-term maintainability.

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Are you ready to make an impact by solving real-world challenges and driving innovation in energy solutions? Join our talented team at Siemens Energy as a Structural Calculation Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the strength, durability, and reliability of our cutting-edge products. You will collaborate with designers daily, contributing to the development of energy solutions that meet the highest industry standards for both onshore and offshore projects. Imagine building and evaluating finite element models to assess static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures while driving efficiency through innovative scripting in Python and MATLAB. Your insights will be delivered through clear technical reports and presentations, making a significant impact on our internal and external stakeholders.
How You’ll Make an Impact
You will analyze and evaluate finite element models to assess the static capacity, stiffness, stability, and fatigue of structures.
Collaborate closely with a team of experienced engineers to develop cost-effective solutions tailored to our customers’ needs.
Create and maintain proprietary scripts in Python and MATLAB to streamline processes and innovate new methods of working.
Deliver clear and impactful results through technical reports and presentations for both internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring
You possess strong analytical skills and a natural talent for solving technical challenges.
As a team player, you stay organized and focused, ensuring timely and efficient project delivery.
You have experience with the Finite Element Method (FEM) and are skilled in creating simulation models.
Hands-on experience with tools like Abaqus, HyperWorks, Ansa, or Ansys is essential; knowledge of MATLAB and/or Python is a bonus!
You excel in communication and enjoy building strong relationships with both internal teams and customers.
A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on structural analysis and strength, is required.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

About the Team
You will be part of a team of experienced calculation engineers in a fun and challenging environment, where inclusion and diversity are key pillars. The group is driven by solving challenging problems and staying at the forefront of developing new methods in the field of strength analysis.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs ,  id nr 287947 not later than 2026-11-12.
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.description:
BIM Specialist / BIM Manager
OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden
Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure
HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.
We are currently looking for an BIM Specialist / BIM Manager to join our team on the OL31 Project in Vagnhärad, Sweden.
The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.
The project involves complex civil engineering works, including tunnels, bridges, earthworks and rail infrastructure. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme while supporting the recruitment and development of a diverse, international project organization.
About the Role
As BIM Specialist / BIM Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating, developing and managing Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes across the project. You will support design, engineering and construction teams by ensuring effective use of digital models, data management systems and BIM workflows throughout the project lifecycle.
The role requires a strong technical background, experience working with infrastructure projects and the ability to manage digital collaboration between designers, engineers, subcontractors and project stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities
Manage and coordinate BIM processes throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop, maintain and implement BIM Execution Plans (BEPs) and project BIM procedures.
Ensure compliance with client BIM requirements, project specifications and industry standards.
Coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models and perform clash detection.
Manage model federation, review and issue resolution processes.
Support design and construction teams with BIM-related workflows and technical solutions.
Facilitate coordination meetings and manage BIM collaboration between project stakeholders.
Review and validate BIM models for quality, accuracy and constructability.
Manage Common Data Environment (CDE) processes and digital document workflows.
Support the production of 3D, 4D and 5D BIM deliverables.
Coordinate model updates and ensure consistency between design and construction information.
Support as-built model development and project handover requirements.
Train and support project personnel on BIM tools, procedures and best practices.
Monitor BIM performance and recommend continuous improvements.

Requirements
Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, BIM Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in BIM coordination, BIM management, or digital engineering within construction or infrastructure projects.
Experience working on large infrastructure, railway, tunnel, bridge, or civil engineering projects.
Advanced proficiency in Navisworks, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, and BIM coordination platforms.
Experience with Common Data Environments (CDE), document management systems and digital project delivery.
Strong understanding of BIM standards, model coordination and information management processes.
Experience performing clash detection, model reviews and design coordination.
Experience with ProjectWise, ACC (Autodesk Construction Cloud), BIM 360, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of IFC standards and openBIM workflows.
Experience with 4D planning and construction sequencing.
Familiarity with Swedish infrastructure projects and Trafikverket BIM requirements.
Experience supporting as-built documentation and digital project handover.
Knowledge of construction methodologies and engineering workflows.
Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international project teams.

 Language Requirements
Professional working proficiency in English is required.
Swedish is highly meritorious due to the project's regulatory environment, documentation requirements.

 We Offer
The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Location
 Vagnhärad, Sweden 
Apply
If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.
Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se, or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/ 
Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

jobs.occupation: Line manager HVDC Service Warranty & Care
jobs.description:
The opportunity
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems.
HVDC Service, based in Ludvika, Sweden, is now looking for a Line Manager to take on the role as the leader for the Service Warranty & Care to support and develop the individuals and the group.
In this role, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of 10-20 professionals reporting directly to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that engineering teams are adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations.
Your Responsibilities
HVDC Services core is to lead and manage employee relations, development and engage relations to foster a sense of community among employees.
Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing employee training and development initiatives
Providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function and operational work together with technical specialists.
Providing insight and managing priorities for the team while ensuring activities’ performance and quality goals are met during all project phases.
Taking a proactive approach and actively participating in recruiting activities.
Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure.
Partnering with the management team to develop, improve, and implement strategic people management initiatives and ensuring processes are in place to capture and share best practices and operational experiences.

Your Background
Experience as a people manager, or other relevant leadership or management experience with personnel responsibility, is highly qualifying.
Experience in technology, engineering, electrical design, hardware design, or similar is required (if you have worked with HVDC technology before it is a plus).
Strong communication, social, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees and management. 
Clear in decision making and have the right inner drive to take on full responsibility for your scope and deliver on time in a dynamic environment.
Fluency in Swedish and English is a must.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various training and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Additional information
 The role is based in Ludvika and requires frequent presence at our office, with flexibility of hybrid working.
If you are passionate about people and how groups work together, we encourage you to apply! Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

Svenska Trädmästarna AB söker en erfaren, skicklig och säker klättrande arborist till vårt team i Stockholm.
Vi söker dig som har minst 3–5 års yrkeserfarenhet, gärna längre, och är riktigt duktig på att klättra, beskära, rigga och sektionsfälla träd. Vi lägger stor vikt bra klättring, och att komma långt ut på grenar för beskärning. 
 
 Trädmästarna är ett av landets ledande trädvårdsföretag, med över 30 år i branschen. Vi är specialiserade på skyddsvärda träd och träd i kulturhistoriska miljöer.
Att du delar vår kärlek till träd ser vi som en självklar förutsättning. Ett intresse för naturvård, ekologi och biologisk mångfald är också mycket värdefullt. Högskoleutbildning, särskilt inom biologi eller ekologi är starkt meriterande, även om klättringen i just denna position är det som är i fokus. 
 
 Vi söker dig som också är bra med kunder och kollegor och som kan och vill ta ansvar för egna projekt. Här finns stora möjligheter att utvecklas och få mer ansvar. Vi vill växa med bra personer och det är så vi tror att vi kommer att forma arboristbranschen i Sverige även de kommande 30 åren.

Konkurrenskraftig lön för rätt person.
Läs gärna mer om oss och se vad våra kunder säger på www.tradmastarna.se.

🌳 Experienced Climbing Arborist Wanted – Stockholm, Sweden
Svenska Trädmästarna AB is looking for an experienced, skilled and safety-conscious climbing arborist to join our team in Stockholm.
We are looking for someone with at least 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably more, who is highly skilled in climbing, pruning, rigging and sectional dismantling. We place great importance on good climbing skills and the ability to reach far out along branches for pruning.
Trädmästarna is one of Sweden's leading tree care companies, with over 30 years of experience in the industry. We specialize in protected and valuable trees, as well as trees in historically and culturally important environments.
We take it for granted that you share our love of trees. An interest in nature conservation, ecology and biodiversity is also highly valued. A university education, particularly in biology or ecology, is a strong advantage, although climbing is the main focus of this particular position.
We are particularly interested in someone who works well with clients and colleagues and who is able and willing to take responsibility for their own projects. There are great opportunities to develop professionally and take on more responsibility.
We want to grow with good people, and that is how we believe we will continue to shape the arborist industry in Sweden over the next 30 years.
Requirements: Category B driving licence, chainsaw qualifications equivalent to Swedish levels A and B, and relevant arborist training or equivalent professional experience.
Desirable qualifications: ETW, ISA or VETcert certification, BE driving licence, chainsaw qualifications C–F and I, training in operating mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs) and using chainsaws from a platform, and Arbete på väg (Working on Roads) qualifications 1.1–1.3.
We are happy to support the right person with further training and professional certifications.
We offer highly varied work, ranging from pruning trees in private gardens to caring for ancient veteran trees in royal parks. We work mainly in Stockholm, but also throughout Sweden and occasionally at Swedish embassies abroad.
Competitive salary for the right person.
Please visit www.tradmastarna.se to learn more about us and see what our clients say about our work.
Send your CV, a short introduction and preferably photos or videos of your work to oskar@tradmastarna.se. Please also send a copy to our Operations and Production Manager, david.rimmel@tradmastarna.se.

Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement
Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services.
More and more of our network runs on open source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you.
About the job
As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed.
Your day-to-day work may include:

Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments

Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms

Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash

Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites

Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core

Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve

Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec

Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure

This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions.
Key skills and experience we’re looking for:

Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments

Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking

Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec)

Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash)

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana

Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure

Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries

Good to have:

Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software

Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms

Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem

Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.)

 Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are.
We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English.
Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

jobs.occupation: Senior Simulation Analysis Engineer - MATLAB and/or Python
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Simulation Analysis Engineer – Techno-Economic Analysis | Sustainable Powertrain & Hydrogen
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Simulation Analysis Engineer for a strategic consulting assignment with an internationally renowned client in the automotive and sustainable mobility industry.
Are you passionate about combining engineering, simulation, and business strategy to shape the future of sustainable transportation? This role offers the opportunity to evaluate next-generation powertrain concepts, analyze hydrogen and other sustainable energy pathways, and influence technology strategy through data-driven techno-economic insights.
We’re looking for an analytical and business-minded engineer who can connect technical performance with commercial viability and help transform complex engineering analysis into strategic recommendations.
🎯 About the Role
As a Senior Techno-Economic Concept Analyst, you will contribute to powertrain technology strategy by evaluating future sustainable powertrain concepts and the energy supply chains that support them.
You will develop, adapt, and use simulation tools to analyze different energy pathways from source to vehicle, combine the results with real-world vehicle usage data, and assess the technical and commercial performance of future concepts.
Your findings will help shape technology decisions, value-chain strategies, and business models that support the availability of sustainable energy carriers, such as hydrogen, when customers need them.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, adapt, and apply simulation tools to evaluate future powertrain concepts and sustainable energy pathways.
Conduct techno-economic analyses of energy supply chains, from energy production and distribution to vehicle use.
Combine simulation results with vehicle usage data to assess the technical and commercial viability of future solutions.
Evaluate the implications of different sustainable powertrain technologies for business performance and customer value.
Identify opportunities to improve product concepts, energy supply chains, and value-chain structures.
Develop recommendations that support long-term powertrain technology strategy and investment decisions.
Explore business models, strategic alliances, and partnerships that help ensure reliable access to sustainable fuels and energy carriers.
Analyze opportunities to improve customer uptime through dependable energy and fuel availability.
Translate complex technical and economic findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Collaborate closely with technology strategy and analysis teams, purchasing, public affairs, product planning, and other stakeholders.
Challenge existing assumptions, identify new opportunities, and contribute to strategic decision-making.

✅ Required Skills & Qualifications
At least 5 years of industrial experience, preferably involving hydrogen technologies or sustainable energy systems.
Strong technical and analytical capabilities, with the ability to evaluate complex engineering and business problems.
Knowledge of powertrain technologies, truck concepts, or related automotive systems.
Experience using MATLAB and/or Python for simulation, modelling, data analysis, or technical evaluation.

jobs.occupation: Master’s Thesis - Leveraging AI for Simulation Model Development
jobs.description:
Company Description
AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach. 

Job Description
Background
Discrete Event Simulation (DES) is widely used to analyze, design, and optimize complex industrial systems. Developing simulation models often requires considerable effort for data preparation, model construction, validation, experimentation, and documentation.
Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have created new opportunities to support simulation engineers throughout the modeling process. AI-based tools may assist with tasks such as interpreting requirements, generating model structures and components, supporting validation activities, automating repetitive tasks, and improving decision-making.
This thesis investigates how AI can be leveraged to improve efficiency, quality, and ease of simulation model development.
Objectives
The objective of this thesis is to investigate how Artificial Intelligence can support the development of simulation models and improve the productivity of simulation engineers.
Specific objectives may include:
· Identify simulation development activities that can benefit from AI support.
· Evaluate how AI can assist in transforming system requirements into simulation models.
· Investigate AI-supported approaches for model creation, verification, and validation.
· Explore opportunities to automate repetitive and time-consuming modeling tasks.
· Develop and evaluate one or more proof-of-concept solutions for AI-assisted simulation modeling.
· Assess the benefits, limitations, and practical applicability of AI-assisted modeling workflows.
Methods
· Literature Study: Review existing research on AI applications in simulation modeling and engineering.
· Modeling Workflow Analysis: Analyze simulation development workflows to identify opportunities for AI support.
· Use Case Definition: Define and evaluate AI use cases that support simulation model development and analysis.
· Concept Development: Design and prototype AI-assisted capabilities for simulation model development and analysis.
· Implementation: Develop one or more proof-of-concept solutions using relevant AI technologies and frameworks.
· Evaluation: Evaluate AI-assisted simulation solutions through practical case studies focusing on efficiency, quality, usability, and industrial value.
Deliverables
The expected deliverables should include well-documented paper and a demonstration for the simulation team, covering the following:
· AI-assisted proof-of-concept solution for simulation model development
· Demonstration case study
· Evaluation of AI's impact on simulation modeling efficiency and quality
· Best practices for applying AI in simulation projects
· Recommendations for future AI-assisted simulation workflows
Research Questions
The thesis should address some of the following questions:
1. How can AI support simulation engineers during simulation model development?
2. Which simulation modeling tasks are most suitable for AI assistance?
3. How can AI reduce the time and effort required to build simulation models?
4. Can AI improve model verification, validation, and debugging activities?
5. How can AI support the generation of model logic and simulation scenarios?
6. What limitations and risks exist when using AI to support simulation model development?
7. How does AI-assisted model development compare with traditional development approaches regarding efficiency, quality, and usability?
8. Which AI-enabled capabilities provide the greatest value in industrial simulation projects?

Qualifications
We are looking for 2 students with a background in one of the following master’s programs (or similar):
· Production engineering
· Systems, control and mechatronics
· Supply Chain Management
We believe that suitable students have completed one or more simulation courses with good grades and possess solid theoretical knowledge, practical experience and a strong interest in production systems and/or production logistics environments. Curiosity about working as a consultant is an advantage. Candidates must be fluent in both Swedish and English.

Additional Information
The master’s thesis will be carried out at AFRY’s office in Gothenburg during the spring semester of 2027.
Contact information:
Niklas Palm, niklas.palm@afry.com, Team Leader Simulation, AFRY Supply Chain Management
Please remember to attach both students’ CVs to the application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the application deadline is November 20, 2026.

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  

Your opportunity

Supporting secure infrastructure design, system segmentation, and implementation of new systems. 

Handling incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and contributing to root cause analysis.

Working with suppliers and internal stakeholders to turn different requirements into secure, practical, and maintainable solutions.

You are comfortable taking responsibility for delivery, while knowing when to involve colleagues or central specialists. You combine analytical problem solving with a structured and security-conscious approach. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you communicate clearly with technical specialists, suppliers, and other stakeholders. You are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement. 

Completed upper-secondary education. Relevant post-secondary IT education is an advantage. 
Several years of experience in server operation and infrastructure.

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet
jobs.description:
Normet is now seeking a Sales Manager to drive parts and services revenue growth and manage key customer relationships across the European mining and tunneling sector. If you are an expert within the mining sector and sales, love to travel and eager to take the next challenge in your career, don't hesitate to apply!
About the role
The Sales Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for driving parts and services sales and revenue growth by maintaining and expanding existing accounts. As an active account management team member, you need to pay special attention to inventory planning, parts consumption, training, and service requirements at the mine and tunneling site level.
What we offer?
Key role in industry growth: A pivotal position driving Normet’s parts and services expansion across the European mining and tunneling sector.
International environment & dynamic travel: Work with diverse European clients and cross-functional teams, traveling up to 75% to key customer sites in central- and northern Europe.
Impact & ownership: Full accountability for key account planning, TCO modeling, and developing tailored customer solutions.
Collaborative culture: Close synergy with Service, Equipment Sales, and technical support teams across local and international offices.

Work tasks
Key responsibilities involve
Business Growth and Functional
Execution of the sales strategy for parts and services, growth within current and new customer base; responsible for leading and delivering on customer-specific monthly revenue targets.
Active management in customer planning with spare parts, consumption levels, and portfolio offerings available within Normet. Identify gaps in customer purchasing behavior and work to create solutions to penetrate new sales.
Active involvement with recommended spare parts kits and total cost of ownership modeling, pursuit of rental and used equipment opportunities.
Lead on-site review meetings (monthly/quarterly as needed) with regular site visits and interactions.
Address technical inquiries, on-site spare parts management reviews with recommended adjustments, review equipment performance and identify upgrades.
Provide feedback for engineering and production regarding quality, parts reliability, and service with an understanding of bringing forward the voice of the customer.
Active sales opportunity pipeline and customer fleet data management within Normet systems.

Financials
Assist with forecasting, aligned with expected growth and actual order intake.
Responsible for developing and executing the sales plan in a profitable and accountable fashion.
Follow up on accounts receivables of orders as required.

Collaboration and Customer Relations
Proactive customer focus to positively support the growth of Normet.
Work alongside with Service Manager and Service teams to manage regional accounts.
Coordinate with the local / international Normet order processing and technical teams.
Collaborate closely with the Equipment Sales team throughout the sales process to identify future capital and after-sales opportunities.
Develop and collect market knowledge. Identify and review the competition and relay this information to the Normet Sales and Service Teams.

We are looking for
A minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and aftermarket sales support. Account Management experience is considered an advantage.
Excellence in written and verbal communication in English. Other Central and/or Northern European languages are seen as benefit.
Willingness to travel up to 75% of working time within Europe.
Experience with MS Office Suite, CRM systems, and sales analytics tools.
Budget/forecasting skills.
Capacity to operate in a demanding environment with competing priorities.
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
An elevated level of responsiveness, organization, and interpersonal skills.
Detail orientation, financial acumen and a strong command of sales tools and account management.

Other Information
Permanent and fulltime position.
Travel up to 75% of working time within Europe. Your home office could be in Sweden, Norway or Austria.
Start: as soos as possible.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!
About The Role
As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join our DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.
Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.
In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.

Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.

Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.

Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.

Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.

Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are
We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.
You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.
AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.
We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.

Strong .NET/C# development skills.

Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.

Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.
Why join Myntro?
At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.
This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.
Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.
Interested? Welcome to apply!
Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.
For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Lema Naderi, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – lema.naderi@myntro.com 
We look forward to receiving your application!

Who are we?
Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential.
At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience.
We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris Consulting: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.
As every role is different, we adapt the process accordingly, always focusing on the best possible candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!
Job description
Join Amaris Consulting as an Android Developer and contribute to a long-term project with our client in Gothenburg, within the Information System & Digital scope. You will join a product team developing and continuously improving a large-scale mobile application focused on digital customer journeys, purchasing flows, and user experience across several markets.
Your missions
Develop native Android features using Kotlin and Android SDK.
Build and improve mobile user interfaces with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
Enhance digital customer journeys and purchasing flows within a large-scale mobile application.
Integrate mobile features with APIs and backend services.
Maintain and optimize existing Android application features to support performance, reliability, and scalability.
Contribute to new development initiatives across several markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional product and development teams in an agile environment.
Analyse technical issues and implement corrective actions to improve the mobile application experience.

Your profile
Several years of experience in native Android development.
Experience working on large mobile applications with high user volumes.
Strong knowledge of Kotlin and Android SDK.
Experience with Jetpack Compose and XML-based UI development.
Experience with API integrations and backend services.
Experience with agile and cross-functional development environments.
Experience with digital purchasing flows or similar user journeys is a plus.
English fluent.
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
Ability to collaborate effectively with product and technical teams in an international environment.

What we offer
An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.
At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.
